en.name: Date Difference Calculator
en.title: Date Difference Calculator – Calculate Days Between Dates
en.metaTitle: Date Difference Calculator – Calculate Days Between Dates
en.metaDescription: Calculate the exact number of days, weeks, months, and years between two calendar dates, with optional business days.
en.description: Calculate exact elapsed days, weeks, months, and working days between any two dates.
en.shortDescription: Calculate exact elapsed days, weeks, months, and working days between any two dates.
en.intro: Calculate exact elapsed days, weeks, months, and working days between any two dates.
en.formulaDescription: Calculates the total time span between start and end dates taking into account leap years and month lengths.
en.formulaEquation: Difference = Date₂ - Date₁ (in days, weeks, months, years)

stepByStep.title: View Duration
stepByStep.instruction: See the breakdown in days, weeks, and months.

workedExample.title: Example: Jan 1 to Mar 1 in a Leap Year
workedExample.result: Total elapsed time = 60 days (8 weeks 4 days)

faqs.question: Does this calculator account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes, leap years with 366 days and 29 days in February are fully accounted for.

faqs.question: Can I include the end date in the count?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can toggle inclusive counting to include both start and end days.

en.notes: Calculates the total time span between start and end dates taking into account leap years and month lengths.
